Interface SlotScreenHook

public interface SlotScreenHook
The plug a slot library fills so its panel-hosted slots (created slots, drawn inside MenuKit panels) take hover and clicks through MenuKit's own container-screen dispatch, without MenuKit naming a slot type. MenuKit keeps the mixins on AbstractContainerScreen (hover, click, scroll, release and the frame's draw order), so two mods never patch the same vanilla methods; the library answers the questions below.

Drawing is not part of it: a created slot is a real Slot that vanilla draws in its own slot pass once the library has written the panel position into Slot.x/y. MenuKit only needs isCreated(Slot) to know where created slots start in that pass, so they draw above FLOW panels and below OVERLAY ones. The element that places a slot also reports it with SlotClip.shown(RenderContext, Slot), so a slot across a clip's edge (a ScrollContainer's viewport) draws and hovers only where it is shown.

One library installs one hook, once, from its client initializer (install(SlotScreenHook)). Without one, MenuKit has no created slots and every dispatch is a no-op.

  • Method Details

    • install

      static void install(SlotScreenHook hook)
      Installs the hook. Call once from a client initializer, before MenuKit's declarations freeze.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if a hook is already installed (two slot libraries would each answer for the other's slots), or after the freeze

    • isCreated

      default boolean isCreated(net.minecraft.world.inventory.Slot slot)
      Whether slot is a created slot. MenuKit finds the layer boundary in vanilla's slot pass, the first created slot, by asking this. False by default.

    • endFrame

      default void endFrame(net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AbstractContainerScreen<?> screen)
      Once per frame, after every panel on the screen has rendered. The library parks every created slot no panel presented this frame (writes an off-screen Slot.x/y), so a slot whose panel is hidden is neither drawn nor hit-tested at a stale position next frame. Does nothing by default.

    • resolveHover

      SlotHoverResult resolveHover(net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AbstractContainerScreen<?> screen, double mouseX, double mouseY)
      At getHoveredSlot, after MenuKit's claim (a panel over a slot makes it inert) let the point through: whether a shown panel-hosted slot takes the point, and which in-menu slot wins it (see SlotHoverResult).

    • mouseClicked

      boolean mouseClicked(net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AbstractContainerScreen<?> screen, double mouseX, double mouseY, int button)
      At mouseClicked: eats a click in a shown slot panel's empty space, so a carried item cannot drop through to the inert vanilla slot behind it.
      Returns:
      whether the click was consumed (vanilla does not see it)

    • mouseScrolled

      default boolean mouseScrolled(net.minecraft.client.gui.screens.inventory.AbstractContainerScreen<?> screen, double mouseX, double mouseY, double scrollX, double scrollY)
      At mouseScrolled: whether a slot region consumed the scroll. False by default.
